articles.title: JD Sports Inks Deal With Grupo Axo to Open 140 Stores in Mexico
articles.summary: Under the terms of the franchise partnership agreement, Axo will operate JD stores and e-commerce in Mexico.

articles.title: JD Sport goes down Mexico way in a more cautious approach to international expansion
articles.summary: JD Sports Fashion PLC (LSE:JD., OTC:JDSPY) is making its first move into Mexico, striking a franchise deal to plant its athleisure brand in one of Latin America's biggest consumer markets.
